title: Embodiment Pakistan National Guard Validation Act 1951

sections.shortTitle: Embodiment Pakistan National Guard Validation Act 1951
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE EMBODIMENT (PAKISTAN NATIONAL GUARD)
THE EMBODIMENT
(PAKISTAN NATIONAL GUARD)
(VALIDATION) ACT,
1951.
ACT No. XXI of 1951
(For Statement of Objects
and Reasons, see Gaz. of P.,1951, Pt. V, p, 183.)
[28h April, 1951]
An Act to validate the
embodiment of certain units of the Pakistan National Guard to support and
supplement the Pakistan Army.
1. Short title and
commencement----‑(1) This Act may be called the Embodiment (Pakistan
National Guard) (Validation) Act, 1951.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Embodiment Pakistan National Guard Validation Act 1951
sections.description:
Validation of certain embodiments

THE EMBODIMENT (PAKISTAN NATIONAL GUARD)
THE EMBODIMENT
(PAKISTAN NATIONAL GUARD)
(VALIDATION) ACT,
1951.
ACT No. XXI of 1951
(For Statement of Objects
and Reasons, see Gaz. of P.,1951, Pt. V, p, 183.)
[28h April, 1951]
An Act to validate the
embodiment of certain units of the Pakistan National Guard to support and
supplement the Pakistan Army.
2. Validation of certain
embodiments.------Notwithstanding anything in the Pakistan National Guard
Act, 1950, including the repeal of the Pakistan National Guard Ordinance, 1947,
by section 19 of that Act, the embodi ment of any unit of the Pakistan National
Guard to support and supplement the Pakistan Army heretofore made with effect
from any date posterior to the promulgation of the aforesaid Ordinance and
anterior to the commencement of the aforesaid Act is hereby declared to be
lawful and valid.

shall lie against or to the (Subs by A.O., 1961 Art.2
